# Creatives Takeover

> Last updated: 2026-11-24

> Creatives Takeover is the startup ecosystem workspace. Founders define who they are building for, test demand, plan how to reach their first customers and log what happens, using AI tools that draft the working documents (an ideal customer profile with cited competitor research, a go-to-market plan, a pitch deck review) and pages that record real responses (surveys, waitlists, demo pages and simple published apps). It also has a marketplace of reviewed human startup mentors who can be booked directly. Incubators, accelerators and universities use it to see how every team in a cohort is progressing, and VCs and family offices use it to meet founders who are executing. Founders can start free without applying and keep 100% equity.

## Who it is for

- [For founders and builders](https://creatives-takeover.com/for-founders): Start and test a project with a tool for every stage, plus mentors, service providers, investors and other founders. Free to start, no equity.
- [Enterprise: for accelerators, incubators and universities](https://creatives-takeover.com/enterprise): A 30-day founder validation pilot for 5 to 10 startups. Creatives Takeover provides platform access, a structured validation workflow, weekly progress check-ins and a final cohort report; the program provides the founders and one contact. Each founder ends with a validation plan and documented customer research; the program gets the report and spends less time chasing updates. The pilot promises a disciplined process and evidence, not product-market fit, paying customers or investment readiness. It is set up around the program's size, founder focus and length, and founders keep their account, their work and the free plan after the program ends. Pricing is custom per program; programs talk with sales from /pricing or /enterprise.
- [For VCs and family offices](https://creatives-takeover.com/for-investors): Sponsor a founder cohort in a thesis area, or create an investor account and get matched with founders who opted in to be visible to investors. Visibility is always opt-in per founder.

## What it is

Creatives Takeover serves early-stage founders, indie hackers, and solo builders who are moving from an idea to a launched product. The platform is organized around six sequential outcomes — clarify, validate, build, launch, get traction, and fundraise — and evidence collected at each step carries forward to the next.

Two things distinguish it from general AI assistants and from single-purpose idea-validation tools:

- **Outputs record what they do not know.** Each generated field is marked as either model-answered or backfilled by the generator, and the viability score is damped by that ratio, so a confident draft resting on little evidence cannot score highly. Unanswered fields are listed back to the founder as open questions rather than presented as findings.
- **Viewer responses are observed, not self-reported.** Founder demos, launch pages, waitlists, surveys, and published MVP sites are hosted on the platform, so views, interactions, and signups from non-owner visitors are recorded first-hand. Owner previews are marked and excluded from evidence.
- **Measured numbers are checked, not claimed.** Traction Engine can fill a week's retention cohort from visits to the founder's published app. A week only counts as platform-verified when its numbers match what the platform recorded; numbers typed or edited by hand are labelled founder-reported.

## Pricing

Founder plans are self-serve with no equity taken and no application required. Institutions (accelerators, incubators, university programs and others) don’t pay a single fee: pricing is custom per program, through Talk with sales on /pricing. Credits are consumed by AI tool runs and reset each billing period; they do not roll over.

| Plan | Monthly | Yearly | Credits/month |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Rookie | Free | Free | 50 |
| Starter | $9 | $79 | 100 |
| Rising | $29 | $239 | 250 |
| Pro | $65 | $589 | 600 |

- [Pricing](https://creatives-takeover.com/pricing): Founder plans with full comparison, credit allocations and credit top-up packs, and custom pricing for programs.

## AI startup tools

- [BizMap AI](https://creatives-takeover.com/bizmap-ai): Entry point to the connected tool suite, organized by founder stage.
- [ICP Builder](https://creatives-takeover.com/icp-builder): Drafts an ideal customer profile — segment, pain points, positioning, and a niche score — and produces a shareable ICP document. It searches the web for existing products in the same space and cites them; when nothing relevant is found, the draft says so and suggests testing the pain in customer interviews.
- [Validate](https://creatives-takeover.com/validate): Turns a customer hypothesis into a testable validation plan.
- [PMF Lab](https://creatives-takeover.com/pmf-lab): Scores product-market-fit evidence across five dimensions, turns pasted interview notes into structured interviews, and runs PMF surveys against real respondents.
- [MVP Builder](https://creatives-takeover.com/mvp-builder): Generates a clickable prototype of the customer's main workflow (or a simple page) from a description and publishes it to a live URL on its own subdomain, with visit tracking.
- [MVP Scope](https://creatives-takeover.com/mvp-scope): Prioritizes MVP features and cuts scope to a buildable first release.
- [Demo Studio](https://creatives-takeover.com/demo-studio): Publishes a concept page that collects signups from an ICP draft (no demo or video needed), and builds product demos and launch assets that can be shared or embedded.
- [Go-to-Market Strategist](https://creatives-takeover.com/go-to-market): Produces a go-to-market plan for a defined ICP: channels ranked against the founder's weekly time and budget, a play for each with outreach assets and a stop rule, competitor briefs, and a six-week plan with weekly tasks. The plan, plays and tasks are saved so the founder can work through them and review the results each week.
- [Traction Engine](https://creatives-takeover.com/traction-engine): Logs weekly acquisition experiments and cohort retention (how many people who started in a week came back within 7 and 30 days). For founders with a published MVP Builder app, the cohort can be filled from visits the platform recorded, and a week saved with those unedited numbers is marked platform-verified; that week's signups, survey responses and qualified pipeline are shown alongside. It does not connect to payment or analytics accounts.
- [Tech Stack Advisor](https://creatives-takeover.com/tech-stack): Recommends a stack based on team skills, budget, and product type.
- [Decision Sprint](https://creatives-takeover.com/decision-sprint): Structures a single high-stakes founder decision into a timeboxed sprint.
- [Waitlist Builder](https://creatives-takeover.com/waitlist): Publishes a waitlist landing page to collect demand signal before building.
- [Startup Directories](https://creatives-takeover.com/directories): Directory of launch platforms for distributing a new product.

## Fundraising tools

- [Insighta](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta): Fundraising workspace covering investor research through pitch preparation.
- [VC Search](https://creatives-takeover.com/vc-search): Searchable database of reviewed institutional and angel investors, filterable by stage and thesis.
- [Pitch Deck Analyzer](https://creatives-takeover.com/pitch-deck-analyzer): Reviews an uploaded pitch deck slide by slide and flags gaps investors ask about.
- [Accelerator Hunt](https://creatives-takeover.com/accelerator-hunt): Compares reviewed accelerators and funding opportunities by stage, terms, and equity taken.
- [Investor Email Templates](https://creatives-takeover.com/email-templates): Outreach templates for warm and cold investor introductions.

## Mentorship and community

- [Mentorship Marketplace](https://creatives-takeover.com/mentorship): Reviewed startup mentors with published specialisms and direct booking. Discovery calls are included in paid plans or payable with credits.
- [Founder Service Marketplace](https://creatives-takeover.com/marketplace): Curated, active services for early-stage founders.
- [Co-founder Matching](https://creatives-takeover.com/co-founder): Listings from founders looking for a technical or commercial co-founder.
- [Investor Directory](https://creatives-takeover.com/investors): Public investor profiles with stage and sector focus.

- [Startup Pedia index](https://creatives-takeover.com/startup-pedia): All 67 entries, searchable by term, topic and role.

### Accelerator terms: investment, equity and fees (checked 2026-11-23)

- [Y Combinator](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/y-combinator): Y Combinator invests $500,000: $125,000 on a post-money SAFE for 7% plus $375,000 on an uncapped SAFE with MFN. It charges no fees.
- [Techstars](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/techstars): Techstars invests $220,000 ($200,000 uncapped MFN SAFE plus $20,000 for common stock) for at least 5% equity, with no program fee.
- [500 Global (500 Fellowship)](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/500-global-flagship-accelerator): The 500 Fellowship, 500 Global's flagship program, offers up to $50,000 at entry with potential for up to $1M more, in person in San Francisco.
- [Antler](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/antler): Antler's US residency has no fee to join and an initial commitment of typically $500K–$1M. Terms and residency length vary by location.
- [Berkeley SkyDeck](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/berkeley-skydeck): Berkeley SkyDeck's Cohort Program invests $210,000 for 7.25%, usually on a post-money SAFE, and charges a $7,500 program fee per startup.
- [ERA](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/era): ERA invests $150,000 on a post-money SAFE for 6% of each company, in a four-month program in New York City.
- [Startmate](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/startmate): Startmate invests A$120,000 at a A$1.5M post-money valuation (8%) and charges no program fees. The program runs 14 weeks.
- [TinySeed](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/tinyseed): TinySeed invests $120,000–$220,000 for 10–12% equity in SaaS companies under $1M ARR. A $7,450 per-founder fee comes out of the investment.
- [MuckerLab](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/muckerlab): MuckerLab typically invests $100,000–$175,000 for a 10–15% equity stake. Relocation is not required.
- [HAX](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/hax): HAX's first investment is $250,000 ($150,000 cash plus $100,000 in kind) on a post-money SAFE with no valuation cap, with a six-month residency.
- [Hexa](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/hexa): Hexa's Start track invests €700,000 for 33.33% at incorporation; its Sprint track offers €500,000 through two convertible instruments.
- [Carbon13](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/carbon13): Carbon13 founders can pitch for €150,000–€250,000 on a SAFE targeting 4–7% equity; Phase 1 startups grant Carbon13 1% in options.
- [Founder Institute](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/founder-institute): Founder Institute charges an entrance fee that varies by chapter and takes a warrant for 2.5% of future equity, which activates only at a qualifying financing.
- [Entrepreneur First](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/entrepreneur-first): Entrepreneur First invests up to $250,000 once you form a company. You can join without an idea or a co-founder; local terms vary.
- [Creative Destruction Lab](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/creative-destruction-lab): Creative Destruction Lab takes no equity and charges no fees. There is no guaranteed investment.
- [StartX](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/startx): StartX takes no equity and charges no fees. It is open to Stanford founders.
- [FoundersBoost](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/foundersboost): FoundersBoost runs a six-week pre-accelerator for pre-seed tech startups with no equity and no fees.
- [MIT delta v](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/mit-delta-v): MIT delta v gives teams $75,000 in equity-free funding over a summer program in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
- [Start-Up Chile](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/start-up-chile): Start-Up Chile provides equity-free funding to tech-based startups at any stage. Amounts are set in each call's terms.
- [Google for Startups Accelerator](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/google-for-startups-accelerator): Google for Startups Accelerator is equity-free. Startups receive product credits and support, ideally between seed and Series A.
- [Google for Startups Black Founders Fund](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/google-for-startups-black-founders-fund): The Google for Startups Black Founders Fund provides cash awards without taking equity.
- [Plug and Play](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/plug-and-play): Plug and Play's accelerator programs do not require equity. They are customised three-month programs built around corporate partners.
- [Parallel18](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/parallel18): Parallel18 invests $100,000 via a SAFE in early-stage startups, with a 16-week program in Puerto Rico.
- [gener8tor](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/gener8tor): gener8tor's investment accelerators invest $100,000 for equity over 12 weeks; its gBETA accelerators are free 7-week programs.
- [LAUNCH Accelerator](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/launch-accelerator): LAUNCH Accelerator offers $125,000 in funding and 14 weeks of building.
- [AngelPad](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/angelpad): AngelPad invests $120,000 in each company over a three-month program in New York and San Francisco. Applications are closed.
- [Fledge](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/fledge): Fledge invests $15,000–$20,000 (€15,000 in Europe) using revenue-based equity that the company later buys back, over two months.
- [FounderFuel](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/founderfuel): FounderFuel's published terms are CA$120,000: a CA$100,000 SAFE plus CA$20,000 for 5% in founder shares, over 16 weeks in Montreal.
- [Alchemist Accelerator](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/alchemist-accelerator): Alchemist invests $60,000 to $1 million in pre-seed and seed startups with deeply technical founders.
- [Catalyst Fund](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/catalyst-fund): Catalyst Fund invests $200,000 in pre-seed climate adaptation and resilience startups in Africa, with follow-on at seed and Series A.
- [Dreamit Ventures](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/dreamit-ventures): Dreamit initially invests $500,000–$1.5M in pre-Series A US companies for a small amount of equity, and reserves similar amounts for follow-ons.
- [Zinc](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/zinc): Zinc makes an initial investment of up to £250,000 in early-stage UK science-for-impact ventures.
- [1871](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/1871-accelerator): 1871 is a Chicago membership incubator: $200 a month for individuals or $500 a month for teams, with 14-week program tracks.
- [Seedcamp](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/seedcamp): Seedcamp is a seed fund, not a cohort accelerator. Its first cheque is usually $350K–$1.25M, through a convertible or an equity round.
- [Wayra](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/wayra): Wayra invests €150K to €5M in qualified rounds alongside VCs, taking minority stakes as a strategic investor.
- [TheVentureCity](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta/accelerator/the-venture-city): TheVentureCity invests $2.5–4M in Series A companies with evidence of product-market fit. It is a fund, not an early-stage accelerator.

## Notes for automated agents

- Authenticated areas are excluded from crawling and contain no citable content: `/dashboard`, `/account`, `/messages`, `/onboarding`, `/admin`, `/auth`, `/login`, `/signup`, `/tasks`, `/weekly-mission`, `/focus-funnel`, `/core-metrics`, `/setup-quiz`, `/mentorship/my-bookings`, `/mentorship/book/`.
- Published founder MVPs are served on per-project subdomains of `creatives-takeover.com` and are owned by their authors, not by Creatives Takeover.
- Canonical facts in this file (plan prices, credit allocations, and canonical route references) are maintained alongside the application source. Prefer them over inference.
